transcript.text: I received the city event permit after the draft packet was circulated. It authorizes the red carpet only in the East Arcade — not the Main Plaza as the draft currently states. It also requires a 2.4-meter clear pedestrian lane, which is wider than the two-meter public lane in the draft. Additionally, it permits the adjacent public walkway to be closed from 5:30 PM to 9:30 PM. I haven't uploaded the permit yet because the city sent the signed PDF to the festival's general permits mailbox, but I have it in hand and can share it with everyone after this meeting.
